name: Illinois Tollway I-PASS and Pay By Plate
notes: Researched from public agency.illinoistollway.com pages (customer service FAQs, About I-PASS, Pay By Plate, I-PASS Assist); the sign-in page itself is a JavaScript app and was not inspected, so the sign-in identifier keeps the family default. Funds are added with Add funds online, in the app, by phone or in person; automatic replenishment charges a credit or debit card a set amount when the balance falls below a threshold. Unpaid tolls: Pay By Plate within 14 days of travel at the cash rate; invoices 30/60/90 days after travel with a $3 fee per toll for passenger vehicles; unpaid invoices escalate to Notices of Violation with a $20 fine per toll. Closing: online, in person or by mail; the account stays Pending to Close for up to 30 days, then the balance is refunded (card refunds to the card; cash/check refunds by check within about 6 weeks). There is no payment plan in the account; low-income help is I-PASS Assist (household income up to 250% of the federal poverty guideline; $4 opening balance and replenishments, no tag deposit, possible invoice-fee dismissal), applied for on a separate form. Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.autopay.methodTypes ['card']: AutoPay tasks use the saved Visa. Reviewer (2026-10-09): FAQ, About I-PASS, Pay By Plate and I-PASS Assist pages re-read; confirmed 50% I-PASS discount, card-only automatic replenishment, 14-day Pay By Plate window at the cash rate with twice-weekly searches, 30/60/90-day invoices with $3 per toll (passenger), $20 violation fine, Pending to Close for up to 30 days with check refunds up to 6 weeks, Migrate to I-PASS under Settings, and I-PASS Assist terms (250% FPG, $4 opening and replenishment, no deposit). Home page link reads 'Log in / Sign Up'. Reviewer (2026-10-09, run 2): no official page mentions a bank account for Add funds, replenishment or Pay By Plate (all name credit or debit cards), so billing.methods is now ['card'] and the mock no longer seeds a checking account.

autopay.note: Automatic replenishment charges your credit or debit card a set amount when the balance falls below a set level.

cancel_service.note: Close online, in person or by mail; the account stays Pending to Close for up to 30 days before the balance is refunded.

payment_arrangement.note: The I-PASS account has no installment plan. Income-eligible drivers can apply for I-PASS Assist, which may dismiss invoice fees; call 800-UC-IPASS for help with unpaid tolls.

payment_assistance.note: I-PASS Assist: low opening balance and replenishments of $4 for households up to 250% of the federal poverty guideline.

guest_pay.note: Pay By Plate charges a card for tolls found for your plate, set up before or up to 14 days after travel.

help.title: I-PASS and automatic replenishment
paragraphs: I-PASS is a prepaid account that pays Illinois Tollway tolls at 50% off and works wherever E-ZPass is accepted. Keep your license plates and payment information current online or in the Official Illinois Tollway App.

Set up automatic replenishment to avoid fees and fines: you preauthorize the Tollway to charge your credit or debit card a set amount whenever your balance falls below a certain level. Account alerts warn you about expiring cards and low balances.
You can also add funds by signing in and choosing Add funds, in the app, by calling 1-800-824-7277, or at a customer service center.
steps: Sign in to your I-PASS account.
Add or update your credit or debit card.

help.title: Missed a toll? Unpaid tolls and invoices
paragraphs: Use Pay By Plate within 14 days of travel to pay missed tolls at the cash rate without fees: enter your plate (backdated to your travel date) and a credit card. Tolls can take up to 30 days to post, so keep the card on file until they are paid.

Otherwise the Tollway mails an invoice 30 days after the unpaid toll, with more invoices at 60 and 90 days. The first invoice adds a $3 fee per toll for passenger vehicles ($5 to $15 for commercial vehicles). Pay invoices online with the invoice number.
Initial invoices left unpaid become Notices of Violation, which can add a $20 fine per toll.

help.title: Close your I-PASS account
paragraphs: Close your account online, in person at a customer service center, or by mailing a letter asking to close it with your return address.

The account stays in Pending to Close status for up to 30 days so remaining tolls can post, then it is closed and the balance refunded: card payments go back to the card, and cash or check payments are refunded by check, which can take up to 6 weeks.

help.title: I-PASS Assist
paragraphs: I-PASS Assist helps income-eligible Illinois residents (and nonresidents who pay Illinois income tax) keep an I-PASS. Household income must be at or below 250% of the federal poverty guideline, or the household must qualify for state cash or food assistance.

Accounts open with as little as $4 in prepaid tolls, need no transponder deposit, replenish in amounts as low as $4, and may have invoice fees dismissed after enrollment. Eligibility is checked through a separate secure application form, and the tag ships free.

help.title: Pay By Plate
paragraphs: Pay By Plate is for drivers without an I-PASS or E-ZPass. Add your plate and a credit card before your trip or up to 14 days after; the Tollway searches for matching tolls twice a week and charges the cash rate.

It works only on the Illinois Tollway, not the Skyway or other states. Deleting the card disables Pay By Plate, and you can convert a Pay By Plate account to I-PASS under Settings > Migrate to I-PASS.
